decisions.decision: graphify hooks use a bare PATH-resolved command, with NO `command -v` guard.
decisions.rationale: PreToolUse only blocks on exit 2, so a missing binary (127) is non-blocking and surfaces a visible prompt. A guard would exit 0 and silently disable a workflow CLAUDE.md calls mandatory.
